description:
Add the seven baked follow-on constants with rustdoc and drift tests to the baked tuning module, and hoist the unnamed literals they default from; no selection-site wiring.

## Background

The follow-on selector migration design (dev/active/7d824b2f/design.md) governs this task; read it in full. Its §2 fixes the two field kinds and the mechanism rule with four structural read-pattern obligations, §3 gives every field its name, range, default-naming constant, read site and mechanism, §4 names the route reporter and test obligation per family, and §5.3 states the ratified amortisation screening rule and the behaviour-preservation argument (defaults name the in-source constants; observable behaviour unchanged when no profile is installed). Design §3 marks the baked fields (gemm tiles, field_vec chunk, prime-route trio, bit-matrix matvec) and D5 fixes the module shape and drift-test contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: crate::tuning::baked holds one documented pub(crate) constant per baked follow-on field, each with the drift test the bit-backend constant carries (baked value equals the committed calibrated profile's value, or the conservative default when omitted).
- [hard] REQ-02: The two n>=512 prime-route literals and the FieldVec dot-product scratch length are hoisted and named as module-level constants at their defining modules, with behaviour unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: No selection site is wired; each family's cutover wires its own sites.
title: Extend the baked tuning module with the follow-on constants
